comment: How the money-path suite reaches a chain. The addresses are not here: they come from data/deployments.json, the same record the app itself reads, so the suite can never be pointed at a deployment the interface does not use. anvil forks the chain named here, so the contracts under test are the ones really deployed on it. Override any address with its NEXT_PUBLIC_ variable, or the chain with E2E_FORK_URL.
